artifact_role: preregistered research-program registry; not a result or trading mandate
design_principle: Predict an economically meaningful outcome from a point-in-time public event state before testing returns.

forbidden_shortcuts: current snapshots used as historical point-in-time records
backdating a later public release to an earlier document date
joining on ticker without date-valid identity
using revised outcomes as contemporaneous features
selecting a return horizon after viewing the return panel

agent_roles.responsibility: Derive the conservative first-tradable time and quarantine ambiguous or revised records.
Map source entities, subsidiaries and sponsors to date-valid issuers and securities with an auditable method.
Turn append-only source versions into explicit event-state transitions without overwriting history.
Build future fundamental, operational and price labels only after the feature cutoff.
Try to explain the result with mechanical fields, common risk factors, publicity and selection effects before accepting language or graph features.
Run placebo clocks, shuffled identity, delayed-availability and revision-leakage tests; publish failures as durable outcomes.

programs.name: Biotechnology catalyst state machine
programs.economic_question: Do point-in-time changes in trial status, results and regulatory state predict the next clinical or fundamental outcome beyond phase, disease, sponsor class and market-implied expectations?

sources.name: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2
sources.key_contract: The live API is a current-record interface refreshed on weekdays; historical reconstruction requires captured versions or the record-history/archive surface.

sources.name: Drugs@FDA/openFDA
sources.key_contract: Approval records identify regulatory outcomes but do not by themselves identify the first public market clock.

sources.name: SEC EDGAR
sources.key_contract: Use accepted-at timestamps and issuer identity for contemporaneous sponsor disclosures.

state_transitions: results first posted or materially revised
first_prediction_targets: next-quarter research expense or financing need
peer read-through within target and indication
programs.minimum_baseline: phase + indication + intervention type + sponsor class + market capitalization + pre-event return and volatility
candidate_model_families: sponsor-target-indication graph with time-respecting message passing
kill_criteria: historical versions cannot be reconstructed without using later snapshots
sponsor-to-public-issuer mapping precision is below 95% on a reviewed sample
the model cannot beat the phase-and-indication baseline on a later-era holdout
performance disappears when the feature time is delayed to collector first-seen

programs.name: Government award obligation and supplier-propagation model
programs.economic_question: Do newly public federal obligations and modifications predict backlog, revenue revisions or supply-chain spillovers after controlling for recipient size, agency, award type and publicity?

sources.name: USAspending API v2
sources.key_contract: Treat transactions and obligations as the observation unit; action date, record update and collector first-seen are distinct clocks.

sources.name: USAspending data-source guide
sources.key_contract: Coverage and linkage are not complete for every agency or award; missingness must be measured by agency and era.

sources.name: SEC EDGAR
sources.key_contract: Use filings for public-parent identity, revenue/backlog labels and competing disclosure clocks.

first_prediction_targets: contract continuation, modification or cancellation hazard
programs.minimum_baseline: obligation divided by public-parent revenue and market value + agency + award type + recipient industry + prior contractor relationship
candidate_model_families: sparse panel regression with recipient fixed effects
kill_criteria: public-parent mapping precision is below 95% on a reviewed sample
new awards cannot be separated reliably from modifications and ceiling-value headlines
the effect vanishes after obligation scaling and pre-existing contractor controls
action-date results do not survive collector-first-seen timing

programs.name: Schedule 13D intent-transition model
programs.economic_question: Do purpose-language changes, passive-to-active transitions and exposure changes predict campaign outcomes beyond stake size and filer history?

sources.name: SEC beneficial-ownership modernization rule
sources.key_contract: Model the 2024 deadline and structured-data regime break explicitly; use EDGAR accepted-at time rather than signature date.

state_transitions: settlement, board seat, tender or withdrawal outcome
programs.minimum_baseline: stake size + filer identity/history + issuer size + initial 13D event return
kill_criteria: text features do not beat stake and filer-history baselines
results depend on mixing pre- and post-modernization filing regimes
campaign outcomes cannot be labeled independently of subsequent returns

programs.name: Structured 8-K operational-shock taxonomy
programs.economic_question: Can a shared filing-state encoder improve item-specific predictions for operational distress and recovery without pooling economically incompatible events?

sources.name: SEC Form 8-K compliance and disclosure interpretations
sources.key_contract: Preserve item number, mandatory versus voluntary context, amendment lineage and EDGAR accepted-at clock.

first_prediction_targets: next filing amendment or quantified update
programs.minimum_baseline: item code + issuer size + industry + leverage + pre-event return and volatility
kill_criteria: a shared encoder underperforms separate transparent item models
language adds no later-era value beyond item and issuer fields
amendments or voluntary disclosures leak outcome information into the initial event

programs.name: SEC comment-cycle risk labels
programs.economic_question: Can review rounds, response latency and topics provide delayed supervisory labels for future filing-quality and restatement models?

sources.name: SEC EDGAR correspondence search guidance
sources.key_contract: Public correspondence is released only after the review is complete and at least 20 business days have passed; never backdate public availability to the letter date.

state_transitions: review completion and later public release
programs.minimum_baseline: form type + issuer size + industry + filing complexity + prior review history
kill_criteria: any study treats the private letter date as a public trading clock
round and topic features do not beat filing-complexity and prior-review baselines

programs.name: Reg SHO settlement-stress state
programs.economic_question: Does threshold-list persistence add information about liquidity stress after controlling for corporate actions, liquidity and delayed fails-to-deliver data?

sources.name: SEC Regulation SHO investor bulletin
sources.key_contract: Threshold status and fails to deliver do not establish naked shorting; preserve list effective dates and FTD publication delay.

sources.name: FINRA short-sale volume
sources.key_contract: Daily short-sale volume is a trade-flow measure, not the twice-monthly outstanding short-interest stock.

first_prediction_targets: return only as a secondary null test
programs.minimum_baseline: size + liquidity + volatility + corporate actions + outstanding short interest when contemporaneously available
kill_criteria: the thesis relies on interpreting FTD as proof of naked short selling
daily short volume is substituted for outstanding short interest
threshold persistence adds no information beyond liquidity and corporate-action controls

portfolio_policy.stage_1: Pass source-clock and identity audits independently for each program.
portfolio_policy.stage_2: Beat transparent source-specific baselines on non-price outcomes.
portfolio_policy.stage_3: Test market and cross-asset labels with horizons frozen in advance.
portfolio_policy.stage_4: Combine only programs with independent holdout evidence and non-duplicative economic mechanisms.
portfolio_policy.do_not_do: Train one opaque model over all events before each source earns its own clock, identity and baseline pass.
